justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces use schematic carved outlines with round disc-like forms and horizontal/curving band motifs, with B clearly including profile birds/animals and A possibly having animal- or feather-like decoration on the torso. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with body ornament, whereas B is a multi-register field of separate profile creatures and signs, so the depicted relationships and iconographic scheme do not closely correspond.
